description: This is a Python script for a chat bot system incorporating speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), language model (LLM) functionalities, and various multimedia processing components. It sets up a pipeline that handles user input, processes audio and visual data, and manages interactions between a client and the backend services, including function registration for image retrieval. It configures transport parameters, defines asynchronous handlers for client connection events, and orchestrates the overall bot execution.

classes.description: Schema for managing a collection of tools available to the LLM, such as function schemas.
